title: RAW UNREVIEWED: physically ordered correction cascades constrain dependency scope before lexical meaning
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. If one identifiable manuscript revision replaces a whole written participant expression and also revises a separate dependent expression, the joint before/after states constrain a content dependency rather than mere local allography. Search only a prospectively bounded material correction inventory; do not infer revision chronology from ink darkness or transcription alternatives. No actual qualifying event is currently asserted.

design.mechanism: An editor corrects content and repairs a grammatically or referentially dependent expression elsewhere in the same complete entry.
design.unit: Complete entry with independently resolved old/new physical states at at least two nonadjacent sites, preserving all unchanged material.
design.contrast: Coupled revision of nonadjacent expressions versus independent spelling repairs, common pen-session effects, and a single local overwritten character.
design.prediction: A dependency inferred from one revision predicts which otherwise unchanged expression must change in a separately bound revision; whole-form profiles and retained counterexamples constrain any later grammatical interpretation.
design.scope: RAW supply only, no new access. Need readable old and new whole expressions plus physical chronology, not an ambiguous overstroke. RCD001 unresolved chronology remains stopped; SIA001 above-baseline additions do not themselves prove revision or content. IDEA865 mark augmentation and IP071 ditto correction are related but neither is this general nonadjacent revision dependency. Independent manuscript states do not equal independent manuscripts; no translation claim.
